messages:
Maria Chen: just finished the affinity + interconnect sweep for the new llm2-70b bring-up. quick TL;DR: NVLink-backed nodes keep latency in check at higher batch sizes, but poorly pinned jobs show big variance on PCIe boxes. details below.

Ajay Patel: nice — did you measure end-to-end tail (p99) or just median?

Maria Chen: both. p50/p95/p99 captured. baseline configs: stock scheduler, autotuned kernels, and two pinning modes (default vs strict numa/cpu affinity).

Taylor Nguyen: can you paste the raw numbers? even a tiny CSV is fine.

Maria Chen: pasted below. note: model = llm2-70b-8k, quant = q4f16 for this sweep. region = us-east-1 and eu-west-1. throughput column = tokens/sec measured over 120s window.

```
node_type,interconnect,pinning,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tps
g5.12xlarge,PCIe,default,14.1,38.7,56.2,11200
g5.12xlarge,PCIe,strict_numa,12.6,30.2,39.9,12800
p4d.24xlarge,NVLink,default,9.8,15.6,22.4,18600
p4d.24xlarge,NVLink,strict_numa,9.2,14.3,20.1,19800
sxm-a100-80g,NVLink+HBM,default,8.9,13.4,19.0,20200
sxm-a100-80g,NVLink+HBM,strict_numa,8.7,12.6,17.8,21500
```

Maria Chen: interesting bits: on PCIe boxes strict_numa gave ~14% throughput uplift and a big p99 improvement. on NVLink nodes the gains from pinning are smaller but still measurable (about 6-8%).

Samir O'Connor: any difference between regions? kernel choice?

Maria Chen: regionally consistent between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 hardware families. kernel autotune picked cuBLASLt for matmuls on the 80G SXM runs, but Triton fused attention kernels on the p4d runs for certain seq len distributions. i dumped the kernel map here:

```
# excerpt from kernel selection log
seq_len=1024 -> attention_kernel=triton_fused_v2
matmul_shape=(4096,4096) -> gemm_kernel=cuBLASLt_autotuned
kv_cache_ops -> custom_async_copy_kernel
```

Li Wang: did you test cross-GPU copies? NVLink locality can change with different slot wiring — did you force peer-to-peer or let the runtime choose?

Maria Chen: we tested two copy modes: peer2peer (forced) and staged (via host). On SXM peer2peer is always faster. On PCIe with cross-socket allocation, host-staged sometimes beat naive P2P due to crossNUMA costs.

Taylor Nguyen: commands used? want to reproduce quickly.

Maria Chen: minimal repro: 
```
# warm cache + pinned run
taskset -cp 0-47 $(pgrep -f bench_server)
python bench_runner.py \
  --model llm2-70b \
  --quant q4f16 \
  --pin-cpus 0-47 \
  --gpu-bind "0,1,2,3" \
  --force-peer2peer true \
  --seq-len 1024 \
  --duration 120
```

Ajay Patel: thanks. can we add a run with q8_mixed and one with prefix cache enabled? curious about cache warming effect on p99.

Maria Chen: already queued q8_mixed + prefix caching runs in the scheduled batch (job 1991234600). CI Bot should post artifacts when done.

CI Bot: benchmark pipeline completed for job 1991234600. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1991234600/ (csv, kernel_map.txt, flamegraphs).

Samir O'Connor: quick observation — when you say strict_numa, are you binding both CPUs and GPU NUMA nodes? i.e., cpu <-> gpu affinity?

Maria Chen: yes: bind CPUs on the same numa node as the GPU, pin IRQs, and enable I/O locality in kernel params. config snippet:
```
net.core.rmem_max=16777216
vm.swappiness=10
# enable io locality
echo 1 > /sys/module/nv_peer_memory/parameters/enable_pin
```

Taylor Nguyen: will pull the artifacts and try replicating on our dedicated cluster tomorrow morning. do we want to make any of these pinning settings a recommended default in docs?

Maria Chen: propose adding a short ops note: default for hosted = relaxed (to maximize packing), recommended for Dedicated = strict_numa when customers require stable tail latency. i'll draft a blurb.

Li Wang: also add a sentence about kernel selection caveat: autotune choices can flip depending on seq len distribution — include our kernel_map dump in the note.

Ajay Patel: +1. also add a perf test in the rollout checklist so we don't regress p99 when swapping kernel or quant profile.

Maria Chen: will do. action items: 1) post a short doc draft in #eng-ml by EOD, 2) link artifacts from CI, 3) schedule q8_mixed sweep results review next Tue.

Samir O'Connor: thanks for running this — super helpful. :thumbsup:

CI Bot: uploaded flamegraphs -> s3://redwood-bench/1991234600/flamegraphs/
